$comment: IP-10D source-representation declaration. Read first. The benchmark treats this as the only scope of any recommendation.

density_model.anchors: 8 deterministic anchors placed on the procedural crystal skeleton (see anchors_seed)
density_model.falloff: exp(-(r / sigma)^2) with sigma derived from anchor spacing
density_model.note: This is a single-source declaration. Any future asset must add its own declaration alongside this one.

applicability: This declaration is read by the encoders/decoders/report. A recommendation is only valid while this file remains the active source representation.
